whatToWatch.text: Two straight losses have this 3-3 team right at the tipping point — and Vegas still has Seattle as a 2.5-point home favorite. Lumen gets to decide which version of this season we're getting.

The pass rush is the separator: 2.67 sacks per game for Seattle against 1.6 for Kansas City. With Chiefs tackle Josh Simmons on the out list (four KC players out total, including Rashee Rice), there's a real path to living in the backfield.

A 42.5 total says points will be scarce, and both defenses have earned it — Seattle's giving up 20.3 a game, KC 16.6. Seattle's thin too, with four out and one questionable, Chazz Surratt, Drake Thomas and Elijah Arroyo among the names, so depth guys have to hold up in a game where every possession matters.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle's backfield arrives at Lumen Field held together with tape: Jadarian Price remains parked on injured reserve, leaving Zach Charbonnet's availability as the week's biggest question mark against Kansas City. Mike Macdonald offered nothing on Charbonnet's progress, so the Seahawks may have to manufacture a run game against the Chiefs with whoever's standing. Few storylines carry more weight Sunday than who lines up behind center in the backfield.
